subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should RFC 0009 make the proposed DSSE, distribution/query, publisher-feed, and client-first-watch boundaries the normative Hosted Feed v1 contract before the linked cross-repository implementations converge?
rationale: This RFC selects durable protocol and security semantics across OpenClaw and ClawHub; a documentation review cannot safely choose those product and compatibility boundaries without a protocol owner.

options.title: Approve the v1 boundary after proof
options.body: Confirm the proposed normative contract once a deployed final-head interoperability transcript demonstrates the producer and consumer paths.

options.title: Narrow the RFC
options.body: Keep only already-agreed core feed and trust rules normative, and move unresolved query, delta, or watch semantics to a later addendum.

options.title: Defer the RFC revision
options.body: Wait until the linked implementation tracks settle before selecting the final protocol contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the v1 boundary after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the proposed normative contract once a deployed final-head interoperability transcript demonstrates the producer and consumer paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is named as a co-author of the existing RFC and is the best available routing candidate from the supplied repository evidence.
